comment: Every table in the public schema, as the database actually holds them.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Three gates on this server read tables that have
never existed — user_permissions, company_members and user_profiles. Each
returned an error object that a catch swallowed or a `|| []` coerced away,
so they were invisible: one of them, rewardsAdmin, was the ENTIRE check on
ten routes and refused everybody for as long as it existed. A permanently
refused admin route looks exactly like a correctly guarded one.
tests/serverTablesExist.test.ts asserts that every table named in a
.from('…') call appears here. That is the check which would have found the
whole class the day the first one was written.
TO REGENERATE, when a migration adds or removes a table:
and paste the names below. Regenerating is meant to be deliberate: if a
test failure sends you here, first ask whether the table is missing from
this list or missing from the database. The second is the bug this exists
to catch, and adding a name to this file would hide it.
knownMissingComment: Tables the FRONT END queries that do not exist. Found 2026-11-17 by the
check this file was written for — the server came back clean, the browser
did not.
This is a ratchet, not an allowlist: the test refuses any NEW name, and
these twelve are recorded so the gate is not broken while they are
decided on. Shortening this list is the only correct direction.
They are not all the same thing, and that is the point of listing them
with their callers rather than counting them:
user_companies    companyScope.validateCompanyAccess throws, catches,
returns FALSE — the same shape as rewardsAdmin. A gate
that refuses everybody. One caller, CompanyContext:592.
stakeholders      three dashboards that are rendered and can never show
stakeholder_*     anything: StakeholderEngagementDashboard,
audit_logs        StakeholderAuditLogViewer, NotificationAnalyticsDashboard.
notification_templates
company_members   the same phantom the server read until 2026-11-17.
user_profiles
user_activity_log
company_documents
company_settings
portals
Each wants one of three answers, and nobody should guess which: build the
table, delete the feature, or point it at the server route that already
holds the data in KV. See tasks/security-audit-2026-11-17.md, P4-7.
